name: Buzz-Bee
source:
“Sharing joy is all I want!”

Buzz-Bee lives for sweets and the happiness they bring. But simple sugar isn’t enough anymore. His treats now need more than flavor. And he’ll find the perfect ingredients, no matter the cost.
